title: GTA 6's Exclusive Selfridges Merch Sparks High Price Discussion
description: UK retailer Selfridges has launched an exclusive line of GTA 6 merchandise, featuring a varsity jacket priced at £2,500 (~$3,352) and a Burger Shot leather bag.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## High-End GTA 6 Merchandise Lands at Selfridges

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to build worldwide, official merchandise is starting to surface in unexpected places. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, renowned UK retailer Selfridges has introduced an exclusive lineup of GTA 6-themed merchandise, bridging the gap between gaming culture and high-end fashion retail.

However, the pricing strategy for these exclusive items has quickly become a major talking point among the gaming community, with some items commanding jaw-dropping sums.

## Premium Pricing for Varsity Jackets and Burger Shot Bags

Among the items currently available both online and in-store at Selfridges, the standout piece is a high-end varsity jacket featuring the iconic Rockstar and GTA 6 logos. The jacket carries a hefty price tag of £2,500, which translates to roughly $3,352 USD. This puts the piece of apparel well into luxury fashion territory, far exceeding the cost of standard gaming collector's editions.

For fans looking for something slightly less punishing on the wallet—though still firmly in the premium bracket—the collection also features a leather Burger Shot takeaway bag, styled after the well-known fictional fast-food chain from the game universe. This item is priced at £125, approximately $167 USD.

## The Trend of Gaming Meets Luxury Fashion

Rockstar's collaboration with a high-end retailer like Selfridges highlights the massive mainstream cultural footprint of the franchise. While luxury brand partnerships are becoming increasingly common in the gaming industry, the ultra-premium pricing of these specific items suggests they are aimed squarely at fashion enthusiasts, collectors, and die-hard fans with deep pockets.

## Editor's Take

While brand collaborations are a fun way to celebrate a major release, a £2,500 varsity jacket feels more like a runway statement than apparel for the average gamer. It's a bold move by Rockstar and Selfridges, but one that will likely leave most fans admiring the merchandise from afar rather than adding it to their shopping carts.
